sloka: ततः प्रीतोऽभवत् राजा श्रुत्वा तु द्विज भाषितम् ।अमात्यान् अब्रवीत् राजा हर्षेण इदम् शुभ अक्षरम् ॥१-१२-१४॥
transliteration: tataḥ prīto'bhavat rājā śrutvā tu dvija bhāṣitam ।amātyān abravīt rājā harṣeṇa idam śubha akṣaram ॥1-12-14॥

translations.english: "In accordance with the instructions by my spiritual preceptors let the articles (required for performing the sacrifice) be procured and the horse released under the protection of warriors accompanied by the chief priest".
translations.hindi: अनेक वनों और नदियों को पार कर महाराज धीरे-धीरे. उस देश में जा पहुँचे जहाँ वे मुनिप्रवर निवास करते थे
